Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Blake Gillingham replaces Jonathan Bond because of an injury.

Substitution, Minnesota United FC. Kyle Duncan replaces Cherrion Valerius.

Delay in match (Houston Dynamo FC).

Substitution, Minnesota United FC. Maurice Malone replaces Kelvin Yeboah.
